thought.text: The wrapper works directly but Apache returns 404 for `/xplan-mapserver`. Let me check the CGI module and test the ScriptAlias precisely:

reasoning_content:
Apache returns 404 for /xplan-mapserver — the ScriptAlias isn't matching. The CGI wrapper works directly (I tested it via bash). The problem: `ScriptAlias /xplan-mapserver /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper` — ScriptAlias to a single file should work. But maybe the query string with `?` is the issue, or the module `cgi` isn't loaded for the ScriptAlias (I enabled cgi). Let me test without query string and check the access log.

Actually wait — the 404 on direct test... Let me check: the wrapper needs the `map` param. When deegree calls it, it uses `?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1` (no map param), and the wrapper adds the map param. That's fine.

But the 404 from Apache means the ScriptAlias didn't route to CGI. Let me check if mod_cgi is actually enabled and the ScriptAlias is correct. Let me test a simpler case.

Actually, the issue might be that `ScriptAlias /xplan-mapserver` (no trailing slash) aliases the exact URI. Let me verify with the error log and try `/xplan-mapserver/` vs the config. Let me just test the wrapper through Apache more carefully and check which modules are loaded.

action.command: apache2ctl -M 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "cgi|alias"; echo "=== test ScriptAlias with trailing slash & no qs ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "noslash-noqs: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "slash: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver/"; echo "=== error log tail ==="; tail -3 /var/log/apache2/xplanbox-error.log 2>/dev/null | grep -i "script\|cgi\|404"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "apache2ctl -M 2>/dev/null | grep -iE \"cgi|alias\"; echo \"=== test ScriptAlias with trailing slash & no qs ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"noslash-noqs: %{http_code}\\n\" \"http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"slash: %{http_code}\\n\" \"http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver/\"; echo \"=== error log tail ===\"; tail -3 /var/log/apache2/xplanbox-error.log 2>/dev/null | grep -i \"script\\|cgi\\|404\" ", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Diagnose ScriptAlias routing"}
